import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from cache import make_key
from service import score

def test_make_key_includes_all_inputs():
    # Test that make_key includes all three inputs in the key
    key1 = make_key("text1", "profile1", "criteria1")
    key2 = make_key("text1", "profile1", "criteria2")
    key3 = make_key("text1", "profile2", "criteria1")
    key4 = make_key("text2", "profile1", "criteria1")
    
    assert key1 != key2, "changing criteria_version should produce different key"
    assert key1 != key3, "changing profile_version should produce different key"
    assert key1 != key4, "changing job_text should produce different key"
    
    # Test that None values are handled properly
    key_none = make_key("text1", None, None)
    assert key_none is not None, "key should not be None"
    
    # Test that same inputs produce same key
    key5 = make_key("text1", "profile1", "criteria1")
    assert key1 == key5, "same inputs should produce same key"

def test_cache_recompute_on_change():
    # Test that cache recomputes when any input changes
    store = {}
    compute_calls = [0]
    
    def compute():
        compute_calls[0] += 1
        return "computed_value"
    
    # First call - should compute
    result1 = score(store, "text1", "profile1", "criteria1", compute)
    assert result1 == "computed_value"
    assert compute_calls[0] == 1, "first call should compute"
    
    # Second call with same inputs - should reuse
    result2 = score(store, "text1", "profile1", "criteria1", compute)
    assert result2 == "computed_value"
    assert compute_calls[0] == 1, "second call with same inputs should reuse"
    
    # Third call with changed profile_version - should recompute
    result3 = score(store, "text1", "profile2", "criteria1", compute)
    assert result3 == "computed_value"
    assert compute_calls[0] == 2, "changed input should recompute"
    
    # Fourth call with changed job_text - should recompute
    result4 = score(store, "text2", "profile1", "criteria1", compute)
    assert result4 == "computed_value"
    assert compute_calls[0] == 3, "changed text should recompute"
    
    # Fifth call with changed criteria_version - should recompute
    result5 = score(store, "text1", "profile1", "criteria2", compute)
    assert result5 == "computed_value"
    assert compute_calls[0] == 4, "changed criteria should recompute"

def test_cache_reuse_with_none():
    # Test that None values are reused properly
    store = {}
    
    def compute():
        return "computed_value"
    
    # Call with None values
    result1 = score(store, "text1", None, None, compute)
    result2 = score(store, "text1", None, None, compute)
    
    assert result1 == result2, "None values should be handled consistently"
    
    # Call with actual values - should be different key
    result3 = score(store, "text1", "profile1", "criteria1", compute)
    assert result3 == "computed_value"

def test_key_format():
    # Test that key format is unambiguous
    key = make_key("text", "profile", "criteria")
    assert ":" in key, "key should use colon separator"
    assert key.startswith("text:"), "key should start with text value"
    
    # Test that different values produce different keys
    assert make_key("a", "b", "c") != make_key("a", "b", "d")
    assert make_key("a", "b", "c") != make_key("a", "d", "c")
    assert make_key("a", "b", "c") != make_key("d", "b", "c")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_make_key_includes_all_inputs()
    print("test_make_key_includes_all_inputs passed")
    
    test_cache_recompute_on_change()
    print("test_cache_recompute_on_change passed")
    
    test_cache_reuse_with_none()
    print("test_cache_reuse_with_none passed")
    
    test_key_format()
    print("test_key_format passed")
    
    print("All tests passed!")
